name: Allium
summary: Blockchain data (historical SQL over 150+ chains, realtime prices, balances, transactions and PnL, Hyperliquid) for institutions and, per the vendor, for AI agents. Three documented agent paths: a hosted MCP server (OAuth sign-in or an API key from a free account), REST APIs keyed from the same account, and a machine-payments host, agents.allium.so, where every priced endpoint is paid per call with no API key, registration or subscription; an agent skill package and a CLI drive the paid path.

payments.notes: Measured 09-11, 09-20 and 09-28 2026, unpaid: priced endpoints answer an unpaid request with an MPP (Tempo) challenge and an x402 v2 document together, USDC at the documented per-call price on Base, Solana, X Layer and Polygon. Account paths use credit pools; how credits are bought is unpublished.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-11, 09-20 and twice on 09-28, no credentials: mcp.allium.so answered initialize and tools/list 200 (48 tools, all tagged auth_api_key) at 06:31Z and 401 with a Bearer challenge at 18:04Z; mcp-oauth.allium.so 401; agents.allium.so free endpoint 200, priced 402.

jobs.summary: Vendor's llms.txt and pricing page: audit-grade historical and real-time blockchain data (token prices latest, at a timestamp and as history; balances, holdings, PnL) for analytics, accounting and reporting, over SQL, REST, MCP and the paid path. Vendor's claim; freshness and coverage not measured.
